title: A Life of Music
text:
Ludwig van Beethoven was born in Bonn, Germany, in 1770. His father was a singer, and he taught young Ludwig to play the piano and the violin. Ludwig started to write his own music when he was only a child. He became one of the most famous composers in history.

When Beethoven was about 30, he began to lose his hearing. This was very hard for a musician. But he did not stop composing. He wrote some of his best music even when he could hardly hear at all.

questions.text: What did Beethoven's father teach him?
options: To play the piano and the violin

questions.text: What can we guess about Beethoven's life as a musician?
options: He wanted to be a doctor
Music was very important to him
He did not like to play the piano
He stopped playing music as a child

questions.text: How did Beethoven feel about losing his hearing?
options: He was determined to keep creating music
He was happy to stop working
He did not care about music any more
He wanted to become a singer

paragraph_translations: Ludwig van Beethoven 1770 yılında Almanya'nın Bonn kentinde doğdu. Babası bir şarkıcıydı ve küçük Ludwig'e piyano ile keman çalmayı öğretti. Ludwig daha çocukken kendi müziğini yazmaya başladı. Tarihin en ünlü bestecilerinden biri oldu.

Beethoven yaklaşık 30 yaşındayken işitmesini kaybetmeye başladı. Bu, bir müzisyen için çok zordu. Ama beste yapmayı bırakmadı. Neredeyse hiç duyamadığı zamanlarda bile en iyi eserlerinden bazılarını yazdı.
